headline: What Happens If I Don't Address Hard Water Issues?
articleBody: Ignoring hard water in your home might seem harmless at first, but over time, it can lead to a whole host of costly and frustrating problems. You might notice mineral buildup, or 'limescale,' on your fixtures, showerheads, and inside appliances like your dishwasher and water heater. This buildup doesn't just look bad; it significantly reduces the efficiency and lifespan of these appliances, forcing them to work harder and consume more energy. Your water heater, for example, can become much less effective, hiking up your utility bills. Hard water also leaves residue on your skin and hair, causing dryness and irritation, and makes your laundry feel stiff and dingy. Furthermore, it can clog pipes, reduce water pressure, and even shorten the life of your plumbing system. Don't let these issues escalate!
